subject.title: Stale .jsonl.lock + stuck typing indicator after EmbeddedAttemptSessionTakeoverError on parallel subagent fan-out

question: Should this issue remain the concrete tracker for the subagent-fan-out takeover failure while maintainers sequence https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89039, https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/91797, and the broader lifecycle umbrella, or should it be folded into one canonical tracker?
rationale: The code and reports show real remaining behavior, but the fix direction crosses session fences, subagent delivery durability, typing cleanup, and optional serialization policy; automation should not open another competing fix PR without maintainer sequencing.

options.title: Sequence Existing Fix Paths
options.body: Keep this issue open, use it as the concrete evidence tracker, and decide which existing PR or umbrella track owns each remaining slice before adding new work.

options.title: Promote Umbrella Tracking
options.body: Move the remaining lock-release and lifecycle cleanup discussion to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101863 and close this only after preserving its concrete subagent/Telegram evidence there.

options.title: Sponsor Serialization Workaround
options.body: Approve an explicit per-agent concurrency or serialization option as a documented workaround, accepting the added config/product surface.

recommendation.title: Sequence Existing Fix Paths
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, use it as the concrete evidence tracker, and decide which existing PR or umbrella track owns each remaining slice before adding new work.

likelyOwner.reason: obviyus owns the protected lifecycle umbrella that would absorb or sequence the broad reliability direction.
